mentions.claim_text: He says war will increase and get ugly in Europe, and that war in Israel will escalate like never before with Turkey getting heavily involved and it turning nasty.
mentions.quote: turkey is going to get really involved with this it's going to get really nasty
mentions.falsify_miss: Turkey stays out. Undated, but naming Turkey as the party is specific and Turkey has not entered militarily.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that every nation and continent will have a major outpouring of the Spirit like never seen before, with demonstrations and manifestations of glory.
mentions.quote: the continents all around the world will have a major outpouring
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition with no measure or date.

mentions.claim_text: He says drones will be everywhere, naming Oklahoma, Florida, France, Germany, Moscow, Africa and South America, flying in the skies in thousands like swarms of bees.
mentions.quote: drones fly in the skies thousands of them they look like swarms of bees
mentions.falsify_match: Mass drone incursions across the named countries.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Note the New Jersey drone flap was the dominant American news story in the week this was given, in December 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He compares himself to Paul Revere riding to warn the Minutemen, saying he is yelling as loud as he can to warn people.
mentions.quote: just like Paul Revere in the Midnight Hour telling that the British were coming
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a description of his own role.

mentions.claim_text: He says the wars and rumours of wars lead into the Ezekiel 38 and 39 war starting over there, and that this will be a time like never before because they are in that time frame.
mentions.quote: we would see the Great War start to take place over there
mentions.falsify_match: A coalition war against Israel matching Ezekiel 38.
mentions.falsify_miss: None begins. Undated, and reading current conflicts as that war has been done continuously since the Cold War.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for a move of God in China, South Korea, Japan, North Korea, the Philippines and Vietnam, and for every Asian person to be born again.
mentions.quote: a move of God in China a move of God in South Korea
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition naming countries with no measure.

mentions.claim_text: He says a great revival is coming in South Korea that will spread through all of North Korea, that he has seen the angel armies coming to war on their behalf, and that there will be a move of God in North Korea.
mentions.quote: there's going to be a great Revival in South Korea
mentions.falsify_match: Open religious revival spreading into North Korea.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated. North Korea is the specific and improbable half of this, which is what makes it worth keeping.

mentions.claim_text: He says people like David will rise up and break the chains of false religion, with lives changed, healings, and public signs such as the dead raised and an arm growing out that cannot be suppressed.
mentions.quote: when you see somebody's arm grow out you can't suppress that
mentions.falsify_match: A documented resurrection or limb regeneration in a public setting.
mentions.falsify_miss: None documented. The examples he chooses are unusually checkable for healing claims, since neither has ever been medically verified.

mentions.claim_text: He says San Juan, Puerto Rico is coming to Jesus in a greater way, along with Cuba and Haiti, and that he saw witchcraft, voodoo and oppression across those islands which the Lord is pushing back.
mentions.quote: San Juan Puerto Rico is coming in a greater way to Jesus
mentions.falsify_match: A visible religious movement across Puerto Rico, Cuba and Haiti.

mentions.claim_text: He says a 1920s or 1930s style crash is coming, planned deliberately to sabotage the incoming administration's agenda over the next four years, and that the Lord showed him America is in the way.
mentions.quote: a 1920s 1930s style crash is coming planned on purpose
mentions.falsify_match: A crash of 1929 or 1930s magnitude before January 2029.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such crash. This is one of the more scoreable finance claims because the comparison sets a magnitude and the window sets an end.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that healing flow in them, that the president and his children be protected, that no weapon formed against them prosper, and that angels serve as Secret Service.
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a protection petition.

mentions.claim_text: He says there are outpouring hotspots including one in central Oklahoma, one in Texas and one where they are, that he did not see them all, and relays another minister saying a named church has an end time portal.
mentions.quote: one of them is in central Oklahoma and there's one in Texas
mentions.falsify_match: Identifiable revival centres emerging in central Oklahoma and Texas.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerge. He says himself he did not see them all, which limits what could count as a miss.

mentions.claim_text: He says that praying the day before he saw a suitcase bomb in Syria, which he believes is in Damascus, and connects it to Assad having left the country.
mentions.quote: I saw a suitcase thing a suitcase bomb in in Syria
mentions.falsify_match: A portable nuclear or radiological device found or used in Damascus.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He hedges the location himself, saying he believes it is Damascus and is trying to work it out.

mentions.claim_text: He says judgment begins in the house of the Lord first and that a cleaning of the house is happening now across America and the world, exposing darkness in the closets.
mentions.quote: my judgment begins in the house of the Lord first
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of exposures in church leadership.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Stated as already happening, which means it cannot fail going forward.

mentions.claim_text: He says people must get fed up with being broke and without a spiritual touch, and that he saw people drive a van all the way from Mexico City to Oklahoma to get one.
mentions.quote: I saw people travel from Mexico City drove in a van to Oklahoma
mentions.falsify_match: People travelling from Mexico City to Oklahoma for meetings, which would be visible at the meetings themselves.
mentions.falsify_miss: None do. Unusually checkable for a revival claim because it names two cities and a mode of travel.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will pray over the escalation in the Middle East and in Ukraine, that they will see some things but do not have to participate or be in fear, and asks to be in the right place.
mentions.quote: we're going to see some stuff but we don't have to be in fear
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition over conflicts already under way.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that the glory come off them strongly enough that people are healed when their shadow passes by in a marketplace.
mentions.quote: even our shadow would touch them
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition drawn from Acts 5, with no named person or date.
